decisions.reason: As a component close to the core heat-exchanger business, finned tubes likely have low carrying costs and useful option value in a growing market, though the firm's broad portfolio means it may still prune it if demand proves only modest.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's engineering- and R&D-led strengths, appear to extend the established offer with relatively low incremental commitment, and therefore still look worth keeping as an option for further commercial development.
